def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform separator, then compare the equal-sized regions on
    # either side of it.
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)

    if sep_col is not None:
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        left_colors = {v for row in a for v in row}
        right_colors = {v for row in b for v in row}
        shared = left_colors & right_colors
        bg = max(shared, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in a for x in row)
                                  + sum(x == v for row in b for x in row))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == bg and b[r][c] == bg else bg
                 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

    sep_row = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    n = min(len(a), len(b))
    shared = ({v for row in a for v in row} &
              {v for row in b for v in row})
    bg = max(shared, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in a for x in row)
                                  + sum(x == v for row in b for x in row))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == bg and b[r][c] == bg else bg
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    freq = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    dominant = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Identify the full separator line, excluding uniform lines in the
    # dominant background color.
    candidates = []
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            color = grid[0][c]
            if color != dominant:
                candidates.append((freq[color], "col", c, color))
    for r in range(h):
        if all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r]):
            color = grid[r][0]
            if color != dominant:
                candidates.append((freq[color], "row", r, color))

    _, direction, index, sep_color = min(candidates)
    if direction == "col":
        left = [row[:index] for row in grid]
        right = [row[index + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
        common.discard(sep_color)
        bg = max(common, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in left for v in row)
                                      + sum(v == x for row in right for v in row))
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == bg and right[r][c] == bg else bg
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]

    top, bottom = grid[:index], grid[index + 1:]
    height = min(len(top), len(bottom))
    common = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    common.discard(sep_color)
    bg = max(common, key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in top for v in row)
                                  + sum(v == x for row in bottom for v in row))
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == bg and bottom[r][c] == bg else bg
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(height)]
